assertions.name: usable_points_of_four
assertions.source: Reading 2 registry has n_atoms=3; deuteron->Hopf has Vol=0; 4He has no SDP link at all.

assertions.name: mirror_pair_ratio_of_ratios
assertions.source: Reproduces the 2026-08-07 ledger's scratch-float64 2.90% at 70 dps.

exclusions.D: Reading 2 assigns the Hopf link L2a1, which is Seifert-fibred: Vol = 0 exactly. The corpus's claimed deuteron match was obtained by substituting Vol(B_3) for Vol(Hopf) -- an unjustified substitution (2026-08-07 ledger §6), so it may not be used as a data point here. TWO reasons now, not one: that match was also quoted as +0.2% under trace convention C, excised by owner ruling 2026-08-09; under the canonical convention D the same computation gives -6.3% and the witness records the assertion as failing (bean qou-jdhm). So the exclusion below is if anything better founded than when written -- there is no deuteron success to exclude, only a near-miss.
exclusions.4He: No SDP binding link exists. The registry stops at A = 3 (solver scope A <= 3; A = 4 needs B_5 Hoefsmit + Clarabel, conj #604 / GAP-A-1). The only 4He volume in the corpus is Vol_4 ~ 8.046, a BACK-OUT from the bond-count model (assuming the law under test), and it disagrees with the provisional doubly-magic 2*Vol(Borromean) = 14.655 by ~1.8x.

data.verdict: scope-(a). The four-point falsification the 2026-08-07 ledger set as its next task cannot be run: Reading 1 supplies zero hyperbolic points and Reading 2 supplies two. The blocker is the absence of an A=4 SDP binding link and the Vol=0 deuteron, not the pending Reading-1-vs-Reading-2 ruling. No claim is made for or against the volume law; the evidence base for it is unchanged and remains two points.

caveats: Two of the four required points do not exist in the corpus. This witness records that absence; it does not estimate the missing volumes, and deliberately does NOT use the Vol_4 ~ 8.046 bond-count back-out as a fourth point (that would assume the law under test).
